question: At which Olympics was Kho-Kho featured in an exhibition in the main stadium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1936**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kho-Kho was featured in an exhibition at the main stadium during the **1936 Olympics**.
 
• The 1936 Summer Olympics, officially known as the Games of the XI Olympiad, were held in Berlin, Germany.
 
• This exhibition aimed to showcase traditional sports from different countries, and Kho-Kho represented India.
 
• Although it was not an official Olympic sport, the exhibition provided international exposure to Kho-Kho.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 1936 Olympics are often remembered for the political context and the propaganda efforts of the Nazi regime.
 
• Jesse Owens, an African-American athlete, won four gold medals at these games, challenging the Nazi ideology of racial superiority.
 
• Kho-Kho is a traditional Indian sport that involves running and chasing and is popular in schools and colleges across the country.
 
• The sport is governed by the Kho-Kho Federation of India, which organizes national-level competitions and promotes the game internationally.
